title: Assertion: No Grant Overlap
constraints: Rule 1: `gnt_a` and `gnt_b` are never high in the same cycle.
Rule 2: a handover needs one idle cycle. If one grant falls, the other may not be high in that same cycle.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Rule 1 is an immediate-style check on every edge: `!(gnt_a && gnt_b)`.
Both can go in one `assert property` with `and`, but separate assertions give clearer messages.
